page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n1.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The memory configuration consists of 32.0 GB of RAM, resulting in a 2.0 GB per core allocation. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear division between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is weak, as evidenced by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling in the bottom 25% tier. However, the 16 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance in stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is average, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 1253.98 GB/sec and uncached large block writes at 48.1 GB/sec, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server represents a compute-oriented hardware profile. It offers qualitative cost efficiency for parallelized workloads that can leverage all 16 dedicated cores without requiring massive memory footprints or high single-thread performance. Tradeoffs include poor text processing performance and the lack of local storage. It is best suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations.
